GitHub: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1386

The current installed `@unbrained/pm-cli` 2026.10.4 emits an unchanged retry for a conflicting get projection when the conflicting selector is the global `--output-include` flag. This reproduces with `--no-extensions`; no custom extension is involved.

```bash
pm --no-extensions get pm-a1b2 --full --output-budget unbounded --output-include item,linked,claim_state
```

The command exits 2 before item lookup with `Get projection options are mutually exclusive; remove the extra projection flag and retry.` The recovery is:

```text
suggested_retry: pm --no-extensions get pm-a1b2 --full --output-budget unbounded --output-include "item,linked,claim_state"
attempted_command: pm --no-extensions get pm-a1b2 --full --output-budget unbounded --output-include "item,linked,claim_state"
```

Executing the emitted retry repeats the same failure. As a control, `get pm-a1b2 --full --fields title` repairs its retry by removing `--fields`, so the global projection selector appears to be missed by conflict repair.

Expected: preserve scope and unrelated options while removing one conflicting projection selector, or omit an automatic retry when the choice is ambiguous. The emitted argv should not preserve the known-invalid conflict.

Duplicate check: searched all open and closed issues for projection, mutually exclusive, suggested_retry, full/output-include, and output-include/recovery. Read closed #1364 and open #1360. #1364 addresses dropped tracker/JSON scope; this report concerns a current unchanged conflict retry after that scope fix. #1360 defines authority-preserving recovery rather than this concrete global-selector repair failure.

Acceptance: execute recovery argv for full/output-include conflicts (global option before/after subcommand and attached values), assert the projection conflict is gone and tracker/JSON scope remains unchanged; preserve the working full/fields repair case.
GH-1386: remove conflicting global output projection from get recovery retries

Reported on installed 2026.10.4: get --full combined with global --output-include emits suggested_retry identical to the rejected invocation. Preserve tracker/JSON scope and unrelated options while removing one conflicting selector or withholding an ambiguous retry. Intake only; this combined delivery has not independently reproduced or implemented this newly arrived report.

Execute emitted recovery argv for full/output-include conflicts with options before and after subcommand and attached values;Projection conflict is removed while tracker and JSON scope remain unchanged;Existing full/fields repair continues to work;Ambiguous corrections do not emit known-invalid retries
Refusal recovery produces executable argv without repeating a known projection conflict.
Reporter shows unchanged attempted_command and suggested_retry and repeated exit 2; no independent implementation claim.
